Metadata.title: Juntly: Local services, real skills
Metadata.description: Find local people and services near you. Juntly brings communities, customers and trusted providers closer together.

Landing.heading: Local services, closer to home.
Landing.description: A simple way to find people with real skills in your community, starting in rural Portugal.
Landing.visionDescription: Discovery, contact and trust without taking choice away from people. Juntly connects those who need help with those who know how.

how.title: From need to solution, without the friction.
how.description: Juntly brings search, comparison and contact into one clear journey.

discover.title: Search for what you need
discover.description: Find active services by category and location, with enough context to choose your next step.

compare.title: Compare with confidence
compare.description: Review profiles, proposals, availability and feedback connected to real completed work.

contact.title: Talk when it makes sense
contact.description: Send a message or reveal contact details only when you are ready to move forward.

customer.title: For people who need help
customer.description: Discover local professionals, request proposals, book services and follow everything from your account.

provider.title: For people who know how
provider.description: Build a clear profile, publish services, answer requests and grow a reputation through completed work.
provider.imageAlt: Professional working with wood in a workshop

trust.title: Trust built into the product.
trust.description: The experience brings people closer without exposing more information than necessary.

privacy.title: Contact details stay controlled
privacy.description: Contact information remains private until an authorized action reveals it.

local.title: Local context comes first
local.description: Categories, locations and service areas keep marketplace results genuinely relevant.

reputation.title: History that means something
reputation.description: Completed bookings support verified reviews and transparent provider responses.

closing.title: Start with your community.
closing.description: Create an account to request help, offer your skills, or follow every conversation and booking in one place.
